Application Information
Tapping on the strengths, expertise and diverse research interest of the faculty members at the School of Biological Sciences, we offer a myriad of Ph.D. projects. These Ph.D. projects are open to individuals who are interested to pursue their Ph.D. under the supervision of professors from the School of Biological Sciences. Ph.D. students are also expected to fulfil course work, teaching assistantship and other requirements.
We also offer M.Sc.* by research. Students are required to fulfil course work requirement and conduct original research leading to a M.Sc. dissertation.
Admission Criteria
A good bachelor’s degree from a recognized university in relevant areas: at least a B.Sc. Honours (Distinction) / B.Sc. (2nd Class Upper Division) or equivalent
Scholarship
NTU offers a wide range of scholarships for full-time Ph.D. studies to Singapore citizens, permanent residents and international applicants.
Ph.D. & M.Sc. Projects
Check out the Ph.D. & M.Sc. projects that are currently available. You may wish to contact the supervisor in charge for more information.
APPLICATION PERIOD
Please take note of the following application deadlines:
For August intake: 1 October - 31 January
For January intake: 1 June - 31 July
APPLICATION PROCESS
Application must be submitted online through the Application Portal.
For the complete list of required supporting documents, document specifications, application requirements, and detailed application procedures, please refer to the Graduate Admissions Application Guide.
APPLICATION STATUS
Please check the status of your application online here.
WHAT TO EXPECT AFTER APPLYING ONLINE
Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview.
Results of the interview would be communicated via email. Successful candidates will be notified.
*Note: The admission criteria for MSc and Ph.D. are the same.
Should you have any questions on the application process, please contact ac-sbs-gs@ntu.edu.sg
Note: The above information is subject to change without prior notice.
